label: H.Res. 159
title: Providing amounts for the expenses of the Committee on the Judiciary in the One Hundred Eighteenth Congress.

items.snippet: This resolution provides amounts for the expenses of the House Committee on the Judiciary for the 118th Congress.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.note: Not checked against lobbying filings (118th Congress bill; 2025-2026 filings are not searched for it).

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

J000289.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
J000289.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
J000289.note: No lobbying list to compare for this bill.
